safety.credentialPolicy: Credential values are never recorded, copied, committed, or emitted.
safety.repositoryScope: Only original user-owned repositories and account-authored branches are eligible for repair.
safety.historyPolicy: Terminal history is classified only by safe metadata and command categories; arguments and secret-bearing lines are not stored.
safety.rewritePolicy: Never force-rebase unrelated history, drafts, forks, or bot-authored branches.

capabilities: safe push of validated user-owned changes

connectorScope.policy: Use a connector only when it is relevant to a verified maintenance action; no broad credential extraction or connector mutation is permitted.

selectedMaintenanceModel.name: daily-repair-review-plus-repository-ci
components: active daily terminal-only GitHub repair review
repository CI on every push or pull request where an executable project exists
selectedMaintenanceModel.rationale: The model preserves the validated daily account-level review and avoids unsupported high-frequency agent polling while keeping code changes covered by repository CI.

repairs.change: Made first-run orphan state-branch initialization tolerant of an empty index and retained manual dispatch while removing the hourly trigger.
Added a non-secret CI-only database URL so Drizzle migration metadata validation can run without production credentials.
Safely rebased the eligible user-authored branch onto main, repaired the maintenance audit so it preserves prohibited account references, and pushed with force-with-lease.
